hook: agent-sim runs Apple's iOS simulator on a Linux VM
hookText: agent-sim runs Apple's iOS simulator on a Linux VM

beats.say: Armaan Jain open-sourced agent-sim, which boots Apple's iOS simulator runtime on an x86-64 Ubuntu VM via x86Sim and gives agents a CLI and MCP server to install an.ipa.
Setup takes about half an hour and needs 8+ CPUs, 16 GB RAM and 60 GB of disk, it downloads the 8 GB iOS runtime from Apple.
It is early, with no XCUITest support yet, and Apple's licensing for running its simulator off a Mac is an open question.
